comments.author: mumblety
comments.body:
By using Astro items, I think this one: Aide Training, you can make books (Captain's Secret Log) which temporarily add one skill to your aide's repertoire. Don't know if the ingredient items are currently in the store though.

A second (more attractive, imo) option will be available in a couple weeks with the launch of Gran Atlas chapter 2. If you have an aide with high levels you will be able to send him off permanently to become a naval officer but leave behind XP and a skill for another aide to inherit... kind of like how ship fusion works. This type of skill assignment is said to be permanent. There is a brief writeup in the post in the General forum titled "The Future: Gran Atlas".

The official chapter 2 announcement from OGP (the one with Astronomy and fireworks) seems to be confirming this new mechanic (very briefly) near the top of the post: "The expansion also come with aide officer function, new quests, discoveries..."

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I could be wrong, but I think the Captain's Secret Log is a permanent aide skill addition item, which is why it's never been released in GAMA (that I know of). The temporary Astro aide addition items are these:

Captain's Manual (15 days)
Captain's Secrets (30 days)

I've also been told by folks wiser than I that in order to sacrifice an aide to the royal navy, at least one of their levels must be 50+, and all their traits at 100. We'll know more about the precise mechanics once Chapter 2 is released.

But, yes... expensive and a pain to do is kind of how MMOs work, F2P or otherwise.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I guess it depends on the skill, and the goal. I know one player who hired an aide (Io) with the intent of sacrificing that aide to the Royal Navy to get the Fire Prevention skill, to make Nanban runs safer from fiery disasters at sea. Royal Navy aides also send you a special gift once a month, though what gift(s) will be given in GAMA, it's too soon to tell.

It is an awful lot of legwork, though, and after all the adventures I've been through with my own aides, I'm not sure I could part with any of them for the sake of a single skill.
